caption: The drawing depicts a single porcelain pitcher with a wide mouth, a curved lip, and a large ornate handle. The main body of the pitcher is an off-white or light cream color, decorated with delicate pink floral motifs, which appear to be roses, scattered in small clusters on the surface. The handle is gold or bronze in color, detailed with intricate, raised patterns along its length. The upper and lower portions of the pitcher are adorned with a textured diamond or scale-like pattern, rendered in a pale gray or silver shade, creating a distinct visual separation from the smoother central band. The pitcher is set against a muted gray-blue rectangular background, enclosed within a wider cream border, with a single, thin gray-blue line forming a rectangle near the edge of the paper.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
